gear_rk_lantern_of_holy_light.name: Lantern of Holy Light
gear_rk_lantern_of_holy_light.help: Create a mobile Glow ward that forces nearby demons and undead to retreat. May go out at turn end.

gear_rk_golden_incunabula.name: Golden Incunabula
gear_rk_golden_incunabula.help: Bind to a spell permanently; the apprentice gains +1 when casting that spell.

gear_rk_the_feather_blade.name: The Feather Blade
gear_rk_the_feather_blade.help: A two-handed weapon that occupies one fewer equipment slot.

gear_rk_talisman_of_speed.name: Talisman of Speed
gear_rk_talisman_of_speed.help: Once per battle, double the distance of a Run For It action.

gear_rk_armring_of_strength.name: Armring of Strength
gear_rk_armring_of_strength.help: Adds 5 to Fight stat tests, not ordinary combat rolls.

gear_rk_mask_of_many_faces.name: Mask of Many Faces
gear_rk_mask_of_many_faces.help: Reduces the opponent's advantage from supporting fighters.

gear_rk_dazzling_cape.name: Dazzling Cape
gear_rk_dazzling_cape.help: Once per battle, escape melee with a normal movement action.

gear_rk_blood_beetle.name: Blood Beetle
gear_rk_blood_beetle.help: Prevents poisoning while its magic is active.

gear_rk_quiver_of_the_hunter.name: Quiver of the Hunter
gear_rk_quiver_of_the_hunter.help: Holds up to four enchanted missiles instead of one. Use the enchanted shot option to spend a missile.

gear_rk_mind_lock_collar.name: Mind Lock Collar
gear_rk_mind_lock_collar.help: Animal equipment; protects against Mind Control and Suggestion.

gear_rk_lightning_brooch.name: Lightning Brooch
gear_rk_lightning_brooch.help: Reduces elemental damage by 2. Incompatible with heavy armour and other elemental resistance.

gear_rk_mindguard_shield.name: Mindguard Shield
gear_rk_mindguard_shield.help: Adds 4 to applicable spell resistance rolls.

gear_rk_icon_of_the_sun.name: Icon of the Sun
gear_rk_icon_of_the_sun.help: Helps against undead in melee and prevents energy drain.

gear_rk_enchanted_scroll_wax_6.name: Enchanted Scroll Wax
gear_rk_enchanted_scroll_wax_6.help: Crafting supply. Spend one use on a successful Write Scroll ritual to create a scroll cast at 15.

gear_rk_slippery_boots.name: Slippery Boots
gear_rk_slippery_boots.help: Offers a withdrawal of up to three inches after melee, including ties.

gear_rk_potion_drinker_staff.name: Potion Drinker Staff
gear_rk_potion_drinker_staff.help: Adds 1 weapon damage. Sacrifice a potion before battle to store its effect for one use.

gear_rk_bottle_imp.name: Bottle Imp
gear_rk_bottle_imp.help: Consume the bottle to release an uncontrolled imp at a legal nearby position.

gear_rk_enchanted_teetotum.name: Enchanted Teetotum
gear_rk_enchanted_teetotum.help: Once per battle, pre-arm a binding reroll of the next random heading.

gear_rk_sticky_finger_gloves.name: Sticky Finger Gloves
gear_rk_sticky_finger_gloves.help: Helps recover treasure during ordinary end-of-battle settlement.

gear_rk_enchanted_vials_6.name: Enchanted Vials
gear_rk_enchanted_vials_6.help: Crafting supply. Potions brewed with a vial may survive their first use on a 19 or 20.

gear_rk_gutter_flail.name: Gutter Flail
gear_rk_gutter_flail.help: Offers a free fight immediately after moving into new melee contact.

gear_rk_hypnotic_puppet.name: Hypnotic Puppet
gear_rk_hypnotic_puppet.help: Nearby targets suffer a penalty to initial spell resistance; failed casting carries an additional risk.

gear_rk_lifelong_plant.name: Lifelong Plant
gear_rk_lifelong_plant.help: Choose a non-wizard casualty to receive +1 on survival. The plant withers on a natural 20.

gear_rk_surefoot_boots.name: Surefoot Boots
gear_rk_surefoot_boots.help: Adds 5 to Move stat tests, not movement distance.

gear_rk_golden_fangs_6.name: Golden Fangs
gear_rk_golden_fangs_6.help: Use one on a successful Animate Skull cast to give the skull +1 Fight. Up to six occupy one slot.

gear_rk_bracelet_of_vigour.name: Bracelet of Vigour
gear_rk_bracelet_of_vigour.help: Adds 8 to Health tests and reduces the optional Wounded threshold to 2.

gear_rk_amulet_of_elemental_energy_absor.name: Amulet of Elemental Energy Absorption
gear_rk_amulet_of_elemental_energy_absor.help: Reduces elemental damage by 1. Arm it to risk absorbing a whole hit; failure destroys it and increases damage.

gear_rk_mantle_of_the_bear_or_leopard.name: Mantle of the Bear (or Leopard)
gear_rk_mantle_of_the_bear_or_leopard.help: Bind to bear or snow leopard. Under the optional companion classification rule, a matching companion counts as a standard soldier.

gear_rk_construct_spikes.name: Construct Spikes
gear_rk_construct_spikes.help: Permanently graft onto a construct to grant the charging Horns trait.

gear_rk_burning_icon.name: Burning Icon
gear_rk_burning_icon.help: Makes the wearer's Banish resistance test harder by 2.

gear_rk_extended_scroll.name: Extended Scroll
gear_rk_extended_scroll.help: Once per battle, extend a conjured Bridge to nine inches; that bridge collapses only on a 1.

gear_rk_book_of_the_foulhorn.name: Book of the Foulhorn
gear_rk_book_of_the_foulhorn.help: Vault item. Permits one permanent Foulhorn specialist for 200 gc; it may injure an ally before battle.

gear_rk_ivory_hand.name: Ivory Hand
gear_rk_ivory_hand.help: Improves Push attacks and damages targets stopped by obstacles. Can be permanently grafted to a magic staff for 500 gc.

gear_rk_ring_of_elemental_fire.name: Ring of Elemental Fire
gear_rk_ring_of_elemental_fire.help: Conjured Walls inflict elemental damage on contact.

gear_rk_book_of_wisdom.name: Book of Wisdom
gear_rk_book_of_wisdom.help: Reduces specialist usage for one eligible monk or mystic warrior when their content is available.

gear_rk_amulet_of_charisma.name: Amulet of Charisma
gear_rk_amulet_of_charisma.help: Raises the specialist limit by one when worn by the wizard, but reduces Will by 1.

gear_rk_scroll_shield.name: Scroll Shield
gear_rk_scroll_shield.help: Roll its spell during preparation. Nearby friendly casters can consume it as a scroll; the bearer starts with 1 less Health.

gear_rk_ring_of_destiny.name: Ring of Destiny
gear_rk_ring_of_destiny.help: Awards the wizard 20 extra XP after a game, but worsens some survival results.

gear_rk_soulchill_blade.name: Soulchill Blade
gear_rk_soulchill_blade.help: Uses the target's Will to determine effective armour; successful damage can weaken Fight, and kills can penalize the wielder's Will.

gear_rk_wraith_bow.name: Wraith Bow
gear_rk_wraith_bow.help: Adds 1 damage. Once per battle, shoot through one obstacle and then test against the bow's curse.

gear_rk_vampire_staff.name: Vampire Staff
gear_rk_vampire_staff.help: Sacrifice a nearby eligible ally's Health to empower casting or resistance. Surviving donors desert.

gear_rk_mystic_shears.name: Mystic Shears
gear_rk_mystic_shears.help: Once per preparation, injure an eligible specialist to add 2 to a pre-battle cast; a permanent injury is possible.

gear_rk_creature_mask.name: Creature Mask
gear_rk_creature_mask.help: Can redirect an uncontrolled creature's melee attack to an unmasked target at a cumulative Will cost.

gear_rk_pulsing_gem.name: Pulsing Gem
gear_rk_pulsing_gem.help: Four rechargeable power points for Blink only, with optional extra distance and direction reroll. Use weakens shooting defence.

gear_rk_staff_of_the_illusionist.name: Staff of the Illusionist
gear_rk_staff_of_the_illusionist.help: Allows two illusions in a warband at the cost of 2 wizard Will; increases Fool's Gold range.

gear_rk_wand_of_brilliant_power_3.name: Wand of Brilliant Power (3)
gear_rk_wand_of_brilliant_power_3.help: Three rechargeable power points. Adds 2 to both Word spells; only wand power can empower those casts.

gear_rk_tiger_eye_ring.name: Tiger Eye Ring
gear_rk_tiger_eye_ring.help: Extends targeted sight around some obstacles and moves a Wizard Eye along its host. Each use risks damage.

gear_rk_circlet_of_defence.name: Circlet of Defence
gear_rk_circlet_of_defence.help: Bind to one eligible spell for immunity. The wizard cannot cast that spell and starts with 2 less Health.

gear_rk_sword_of_woe.name: Sword of Woe
gear_rk_sword_of_woe.help: Adds 2 Fight and 1 Will, but losses harm the bearer and a natural 1 can harm a supporting ally.

gear_rk_mask_of_death.name: Mask of Death
gear_rk_mask_of_death.help: Toggle undead status in place of a move. Wearing it at any point removes the wizard's usual survival bonus.

gear_rk_ring_of_levitation.name: Ring of Levitation
gear_rk_ring_of_levitation.help: Grants levitation movement benefits but reduces Will by 3.

gear_rk_skull_staff.name: Skull Staff
gear_rk_skull_staff.help: Expands skull and zombie limits, strengthens summons and modifies their casting rolls.

gear_rk_gloves_of_the_worm_rider.name: Gloves of the Worm Rider
gear_rk_gloves_of_the_worm_rider.help: Uncontrolled worms avoid the wearer. Once per battle, place a delayed worm arrival marker; survival rolls carry an extra risk.

gear_rk_golden_bottle_of_yens.name: Golden Bottle of Yens
gear_rk_golden_bottle_of_yens.help: Brew two doses into the bottle. Drinking requires a Will test; failure poisons the drinker.

gear_rk_sword_of_elemental_fire.name: Sword of Elemental Fire
gear_rk_sword_of_elemental_fire.help: Charges when Elementalist spells are cast. Releases stored elemental damage on a successful hit; a natural 1 can injure the bearer.

gear_rk_recruit_staff.name: Recruit's magical staff
gear_rk_recruit_staff.help: A magical staff granting +1 Fight when used.

gear_rk_recruit_hand_weapon.name: Recruit's magical hand weapon
gear_rk_recruit_hand_weapon.help: A magical hand weapon granting +1 Fight when used.

gear_rk_recruit_two_handed.name: Recruit's magical two handed
gear_rk_recruit_two_handed.help: A magical two-handed weapon granting +1 Fight when used.

gear_rk_recruit_dagger.name: Recruit's magical dagger
gear_rk_recruit_dagger.help: A magical dagger granting +1 Fight when used.
